onnx.output: mean action (pre-clip); the runtime clips to [-1, 1]

arena.note: 2.4384 m (8 ft) square, origin at the centre, +x right, +y up, yaw CCW from +x

actuation.throttle: PWM duty in [-1, 1], + forward (motor driver on the car)
actuation.steer: proportional steering target, fraction of max_steer_rad, + left
actuation.trained_with: 70% proportional / 30% on-off steering, 50% of episodes with a one-step (0.1 s) command delay; observations through the two-corner-camera emulator

notes: Pose inputs only: (x, y, heading) per car from the cameras; signed speed from consecutive poses (the loop's SignedSpeed); yaw rate, steering target and last command are tracked inside the runtime.
